We have evidence about 2010 Asian Games basketball venues: "The event was held at the 13,000 seat Guangzhou International Sports Arena, Huangpu Gymnasium, Guangti Gymnasium, Ying Dong Gymnasium and Sports and Entertainment Centre." So Guangzhou International Sports Arena has 13,000 seats.

For 2014 Asian Games men's basketball: "Games of the tournament were held at the 7,406 seat Samsan World Gymnasium, and the 5,158 seat Hwaseong Sports Complex." So the largest is Samsan World Gymnasium with 7,406 seats.

Thus between 2010 and 2014, the stadium with most seats is Guangzhou International Sports Arena (13,000 seats) vs Samsan World Gymnasium (7,406). So answer: Guangzhou International Sports Arena.
